title: $k-$Generalized Fibonacci numbers as Concatenation of Three Repdigits
content: The $k$-Fibonacci sequence is a generalization of the classic Fibonacci sequence with some fixed integer $k \geq 2$. In this paper, we identify all $k$-Fibonacci numbers which can be represented as concatenation of three repdigits. This work builds upon and extends the previous research by Erduvan and Keskin, who identified all the Fibonacci numbers with this property. The computations were carried out with the help of a simple computer program in $Mathematica$.
